summary: Each requested call recomputes the complete owned row range, then all-gathers its output. Static storage caches allocation/partition metadata, not the product.

source_evidence.claim: The last rank receives all remainder rows, so ownership covers the full matrix. The kernel's multiplication loop is unconditional for nonempty ranges on every original-count timed invocation.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed call 9c78 repeats via 9c87->9c50. Its target retains multiply/add a50c/a514 under entry a51b and row a539/a54c loops before MPI_Allgatherv. Allocation guards return to row computation.
